beats.name: Entrance of the Noble Warrior
beats.prompt: Raise the heroic Rathore chieftain with saffron safaa and shining shield.

beats.name: The Unbroken Vow
beats.prompt: Pinch the control crossbar firmly to assert steadfast loyalty and courage.

beats.name: The March Across the Durbar
beats.prompt: Stride steadily across the courtyard floor; every step echoes with honor.

beats.name: Defiance of Tyranny
beats.prompt: Tilt high as symbolic banners wave; a bloodless, dignified victory of truth.

beats.name: The Warrior's Bow
beats.prompt: A solemn bow of respect to the heritage of Rajasthan, met with thunderous applause.

meetTheMaker.title: Meet the Maker: The Heroic Rathore Puppet
meetTheMaker.description: Amar Singh Rathore is the undisputed hero of the traditional Bhat repertoire. His doll is carved larger than common courtiers, featuring a majestic curled moustache, a heavy saffron turban wound with golden zari cord, and a wooden shield covered in hammered copper foil.
meetTheMaker.communityDedication: In tribute to the hereditary Bhat storytellers who keep historical memories alive through song and string.
